projects.title: 📊 Finance Performance Branch Analysis
projects.description:
Conducted a branch financial performance analysis using Power BI to evaluate disbursement performance and identify performance differences across branch age groups in May 2020.

🛠️ **Methodology**

The project utilized Power BI to analyze branch-level financial data and compare disbursement performance across three branch age groups:

- 📊 0–1 month
- 📊 2–3 months
- 📊 4+ months

The analysis focused on total disbursement, average disbursement, branch-level performance, and identification of underperforming branches.

🎯 **Key Results**

- 🥇 **Highest Branch Disbursement:** Branch AB achieved approximately IDR 270 million.
- 📈 **Highest Average Performance:** Branches aged 4+ months recorded the highest average disbursement at approximately IDR 260 million per branch.
- ⚠️ **Underperforming Branches:** The analysis identified AV (0–1 month), AL (2–3 months), and AD (4+ months) as underperforming branches within their respective age groups.

💡 **Conclusion**

The findings provide business insights for improving branch performance through targeted monitoring of low-performing branches, evaluation of performance gaps, and establishment of performance benchmarks based on branch age.

The project includes an interactive Power BI dashboard, dataset, analysis documentation, and project files available through GitHub.

🛠️ **Tools:** Power BI, CSV, Data Analysis, Data Visualization

projects.title: 🏦 Treasury & Wealth Management System
projects.description:
Developed a personal Treasury & Wealth Management System using Python and Streamlit to simulate financial transaction monitoring and customer portfolio analysis.

🛠️ **Methodology**

The system was developed using Python and Streamlit, with simulated financial data and an interactive dashboard architecture.

**Key Features:**

- 💰 Treasury transaction dashboard
- 📊 Customer portfolio analysis
- 💱 Currency and product exposure monitoring
- 🚦 Internal limit monitoring
- 📝 Transaction management
- 📂 Excel/CSV data import
- 🔐 Role-based access control
- 📈 Interactive financial analytics

🎯 **Key Results**

The system integrates financial business logic, transaction monitoring, portfolio analysis, and interactive data visualization into a single application.

It also supports Excel/CSV data import and simulated transaction processing to demonstrate a practical financial analytics workflow.

💡 **Conclusion**

This project demonstrates the integration of financial business logic, data analytics, and dashboard development using Python and Streamlit to support financial monitoring and data-driven decision-making.

🛠️ **Tools:** Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Plotly, SQLite, OpenPyXL

projects.title: 📈 XAUUSD Closing Price Analysis & Prediction
projects.description:
Conducted a XAUUSD (Gold) closing price analysis and prediction project using historical market data to improve price prediction beyond the technical analysis tools available in MetaTrader 4 (MT4).

🛠️ **Methodology**

The project utilized RapidMiner and applied two machine learning algorithms:

- 📈 Linear Regression
- 🤖 Support Vector Machine (SVM)

Three training-testing split ratios were evaluated:

- 📊 80:20
- 📊 70:30
- 📊 60:40

Model performance was evaluated using Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) to compare prediction accuracy.

🎯 **Key Results**

- 🥇 **Linear Regression:** Best RMSE of 8.744 using a 70:30 split.
- 📉 **SVM:** Best RMSE of 10.318 using an 80:20 split.
- 🏆 **Best Model:** Linear Regression achieved a lower prediction error than SVM.

💡 **Conclusion**

The results demonstrate that integrating Machine Learning and external data analysis tools can provide a more measurable approach to XAUUSD price prediction and support data-driven trading decisions.

🛠️ **Tools:** RapidMiner, Linear Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), RMSE, MetaTrader 4, Machine Learning
